Why do most people lose money? Kevin names three habits.

He explains the rules he sets before he sits down at a casino table, and they apply to any risk. First, a clear win goal, and he stops the moment he hits it. Second, a loss limit, a stop he never crosses. Third, a time limit, one hour at most.

Kevin calls it a mindset more than a system. Discipline is decided before the game starts.

Which of the three would you find hardest to keep?

#ad #mindset #money #habits

15 years of experience, or one year repeated 15 times?

Kevin remembers a man who came to him for a sales job and claimed 15 years in sales and marketing. After a short talk, Kevin told him he really had one year of experience repeated 15 times, because he stopped learning once he thought he knew it all.

Kevin says people can be the same way, and that he is still learning every week.

What have you learned lately that surprised you?

#ad #mindset #success #habits

Stop saying you'll be happy when you get there.

Kevin explains how many people think they'll feel good once they get married, have kids, or reach some big goal. He says it doesn't work that way. When you get the thing, the feeling fades and you start looking for the next one.

His point is that success is a journey, not a destination. You have to feel good now, because there's no happily ever after in real life.

What are you waiting for before you let yourself feel good?
